title: Ohr Sameach on Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly Blessing
text:
And if not, he should wait until the prayer leader begins to pray aloud, and pray with him quietly, word by word.
Certainly the individual must recite "Lord, open my lips," and the cantor also says aloud "Lord, open my lips." However, the language of Rav Hai Goan in the Rif is as follows: "When the prayer leader begins, he starts with 'Lord, open my lips' and says the words with the prayer leader quietly, etc." This proves that this "begins" refers to the individual, because the prayer leader does not say "Lord, open my lips" (or perhaps, as written in the Magen Avraham, the prayer leader says it quietly). And as is evident from the language of Rabbeinu [Karo], who ruled in Shulchan Aruch sections 111 and 123—see there in Beit Yosef.
heTitle: אור שמח על משנה תורה, הלכות תפילה וברכת כהנים
